name: kobel
description: Rich Kobel language support: LSP diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, cross-file references & rename, code actions, signature help, highlights, workspace symbols, formatting, and autocompletion

kobel.compilerPath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the Kobel compiler executable (e.g. build/kobel.exe). When empty, auto-detects build/kobel.exe, build/seed/kobel_seed.exe, kobel_v1.exe, kobel.exe, or 'kobel' on PATH.

kobel.deadCode.enabled.description: Highlight and report dead code in Kobel files via LSP (unused imports, unused variables/parameters, unused private declarations, and unreachable code).

kobel.deadCode.severity.description: Severity level used for dead code diagnostics in VS Code (all dead code ranges are also faded via DiagnosticTag.Unnecessary).

kobel.lint.enabled.description: Report Kobel simplification and mutability lint warnings via LSP (unmutated 'var'/'&self', redundant 'else', boolean simplifications, expression body '=>', etc.).

kobel.lint.severity.description: Severity level used for Kobel simplification lints in VS Code ('server' uses warning).

kobel.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inferred type inlay hints for variables, destructuring, loops, error catches, arrow functions, and lambdas.

kobel.lsp.maxMemoryMB.description: Soft/hard memory watchdog ceiling in MB for the persistent Kobel Language Server (trims inactive tab cache above 75%, restarts if still above 100%; set to 0 to disable).

kobel.lsp.autoRestartOnBuild.description: Automatically restart the persistent Kobel Language Server when the workspace compiler binary (e.g. build/kobel.exe) is rebuilt.
